meaning: Technology that reads written words out loud in a computer-made voice.
clues: A computer voice reads out words that were written down.
It is a feature many phones and computers have built in.
It can read your messages, web pages, or book pages out loud.
It helps people who cannot see well, or who want to listen while their eyes are busy.
It has three words, with "to" in the middle. The first word starts with T.
assumes: Speech to text types out what you say
An audiobook is read aloud by a person

decoys.meaning: Technology that listens to spoken words and turns them into typed words.
A recording of a book read out loud by a person.
A system of raised dots that people read by touch.

exchange.speaker: floyd
exchange.text: The first computer voices I heard sounded like a robot with a cold. Bless them, they tried!

exchange.speaker: bud
exchange.text: Today they sound much more natural. Tip: look in Accessibility settings for Spoken Content on iPhone or Select to Speak on Android.

sources.name: Apple Support, Hear iPhone speak the screen, selected text, and typing feedback
Android Accessibility Help, Use Select to Speak
